findings.established: 22 sparse AD taper caution/form/clarification cases omit age but inherit adult_source_population from their dense adult fixture. This differs from correctly not_assessed minimal references; projected records retain the same unsupported population tag.
findings.primary_rule: Adult source applicability cannot be confirmed from an omitted patient age. Source-only adult reference must remain conditional; it is not a patient-specific adult plan.
findings.source_provenance: source_read_registry.json: exact sameSHA actual own primary reading reused; source norms unchanged.
findings.medical_effect: No individual dose, taper period/calendar or new clinical permission is returned by these22; source actions have independent own actor-phase evidence. No critical medical dose defect established.
findings.safe_fix: Set population_applicability=not_assessed whenever age is absent/unknown/not_assessed; alternatively omit population metadata outside a bounded action/form scope. Keep adult_source_reference_only as a source limitation, not patient assessment.
findings.closure: All22 raw and projected metadata corrected; generic assertion permits adult_source_population only with actually supplied known age18+. Isolated fake adult metadata mutation rejected. Other227 medical scope/data unchanged and new SHA verified.
